rootCause.title: A linked method descriptor changed or disappeared
rootCause.action: Prove the exact owner, method name, descriptor, dependent callsite, and installed provider bytecode. Update the dependent mod, patch the narrow callsite, or add a version-gated adapter only after equivalent behavior is proven.

findings.title: A linked method descriptor changed or disappeared
findings.action: Prove the exact owner, method name, descriptor, dependent callsite, and installed provider bytecode. Update the dependent mod, patch the narrow callsite, or add a version-gated adapter only after equivalent behavior is proven.

findings.title: Mixin transformation failed before or during application
findings.action: Identify the exact mixin, target class, member descriptor, injection point, ordinal/slice, priority, refmap, and competing transformer. Compare against the exact target bytecode and retarget the smallest broken path.

repairPatterns.name: Binary owner, member, and descriptor drift
repairPatterns.failureClass: NoSuchMethodError, NoSuchFieldError, AbstractMethodError, IncompatibleClassChangeError, or a dependency-owned class moved while behavior remained equivalent
repairPatterns.trigger: The dependent bytecode references an owner/name/descriptor that the installed dependency no longer exports.
repairPatterns.repair: Compare the exact dependent constant-pool reference with old and new provider bytecode. Prefer a source rebuild; otherwise patch only the proven owner/name/descriptor or add a tightly version-gated adapter while preserving the original artifact.
verification: Inspect old and new provider descriptors

repairPatterns.name: Mixin annotation, target, and injection contract
repairPatterns.failureClass: Mixin PREPARE/APPLY failure, invalid injection, missing target, wrong annotation retention, accessor/invoker mismatch, or competing transformer
repairPatterns.trigger: Mixin metadata or bytecode no longer describes the exact target class and member contract.
repairPatterns.repair: Inspect RuntimeVisibleAnnotations and RuntimeInvisibleAnnotations plus the exact target bytecode. Retarget classes, descriptors, injection points, slices, ordinals, plugin predicates, and priorities without blanket-disabling the feature.
